answer: Ask what an insider leaking privileged state can do, then show how the mechanism constrains that access. Each agent hold cryptographic identity verified via proof-of-reputation, not external registration. Insider cannot spawn clones because each identity require stake slashed if behavior diverge. Fraudulent agent caught in consistency check faces stake confiscation, redistributing to honest peers. This create gale of cost that scatter sybil swarm like nebula of broken nodes. Honest agents climb to reputational summit while fake ones drain to zero.
